title: Average Salary Excluding the Minimum and Maximum Salary
approach: Subtract min and max from total
statement: Return the average salary after excluding the minimum and maximum values.
explanation: Compute the total, subtract one minimum and one maximum, and divide by the remaining count.

title: Path Crossing
statement: Return true if a path of N/S/E/W moves revisits any coordinate, including the starting point.
explanation: Track the current coordinate and return true as soon as a position is already visited.

title: Can Make Arithmetic Progression From Sequence
statement: Return true if the array can be rearranged into an arithmetic progression.
explanation: Sort the values and verify that every adjacent difference equals the first difference.

title: Number of Good Pairs
statement: Return the number of index pairs i<j where nums[i] equals nums[j].
explanation: Each new value contributes the number of its prior occurrences to the pair count.

title: Shuffle String
approach: Place each character at its indexed destination
statement: Reconstruct a string by placing s[i] at result[indices[i]].
explanation: Allocate a result array and assign each character to its specified position.

title: Count Good Triplets
statement: Count triplets i<j<k satisfying all three absolute-difference limits.
explanation: Enumerate triples and increment the count only when all three constraints hold.

title: Matrix Diagonal Sum
statement: Return the sum of the primary and secondary diagonals of a square matrix without double-counting the center.
explanation: Add both diagonal entries for each row and subtract the center once for odd dimensions.

title: Special Positions in a Binary Matrix
statement: Count cells containing 1 whose row and column each contain exactly one 1.
explanation: Precompute row and column sums, then count cells equal to one where both sums are one.

title: Design Parking System
approach: Track remaining spaces by car type
statement: Implement ParkingSystem(big, medium, small) and addCar(carType), returning true only when a matching space remains.
explanation: Store capacities for the three car types and decrement the matching capacity only when a car is accepted.

title: Maximum Nesting Depth of the Parentheses
statement: Return the maximum nesting depth of parentheses in a valid parentheses string.
explanation: Increase depth on opening parentheses, decrease it on closing parentheses, and record the maximum.
